outcomes.raw_text: Understand the importance of environment and resource management

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Analyse and incorporate the essence of environment implications in their day today decision makin

lecture_topics: Introduction to Environmental Science and Sustainable Development - Earth, Man and environment, ecosystem, pathways in ecosystem
Physic-Chemical and Biological factors in the environment
Concepts and principles of Sustainable Development
Ecology and Biodiversity - Structure & functions of ecosystem, biodiversity and it’s conservation
Natural Resources – Forest resources, water resources, energy resources, land resources and mineral resources
Air quality management – air pollution sources, air pollution & health impacts and air pollution control and management
Water quality management – water pollution, water and wastewater treatment and management
Solid and hazardous waste management – types of waste, health and environmental issues and waste management
Environmental Management System - ISO 14000 series and ISO 14001, environmental policy, environmental performance evaluation, ecolabelling and corporate social responsibility
Energy and Environment – Renewable and non- renewable sources of energy and its impact on human health and environment
Environmental Decision Making Tools - Environmental impact assessment, Environmental risk assessment, Monitoring and evaluation technique, Life cycle assessment and Environmental modelling
Contemporary Environmental Issues - Rain water harvesting, global warming and climatic change, climate vulnerability, carbon/ecological footprints, green economy and sustainable urbanism

resources.title: Gilbert M. M. and Wendell E. (2008). Introduction to environmental engineering and science, Prentice Hall, 2008

Odum E.P. (2007) Ecology: A Bridge between Science and Society.
